texts: A White Car Parked On A Coastal Road
une voiture blanche au bord de la mer

a photo of a white electric car parked on a dirt road above the ocean, with hills, dry grass, a blue sky and a few clouds behind it, taken on a sunny afternoon in late summer near the coast of california, where the road winds along the cliffs and the waves break on the rocks far below while a light breeze moves the tall grass on the slope next to the car
